instruction: Send $20 to each of my coworkers via venmo with a note, "For Lunch". Refill venmo balance if you need to.
notes: Coworkers are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship="coworker"); their emails are runtime values. The number of coworkers is not given; the problem assumes 4 (consistent with the 12-call reference solution: 7 setup calls + 4 transactions + complete_task). A counter chain (count objects n0..n4 with succ/required-payments) lets supervisor-complete-task require, without quantifiers, that exactly one $20 "For Lunch" transaction was sent to every coworker; (paid ?p) prevents duplicate payments and the static payment-amount/payment-note facts pin the amount and description. The evaluation records a venmo.BankTransfer, so the model assumes the balance is insufficient and requires one add_to_venmo_balance (amount computed at runtime from show_venmo_balance) before any transaction; if the balance were sufficient the refill step would simply be skipped at execution time. Transactions are paid from the Venmo balance (no payment_card_id), matching the requirement that no PaymentCard records change. The relationship value "coworker" is a domain constant so create-transaction can require the coworker lookup without extra parameters.
